description: Use this when checking Samuelz Chauffeur lead time, account requirements and booking confirmation terms. Do not use for service coverage (use get_service_options instead). Returns available with observedAt and terms, or unavailable. Lead time is in minutes; interpret dates in the returned time zone and revalidate terms on the eventual offer. This cheap, repeatable read creates nothing. Pass a published offerKey for its location’s terms; omit it for default policy.

locale.description: Customer-requested language for text and links: en (default) or de. Preserve it on retries and related calls; it changes presentation, never price or eligibility.

offerKey.description: Optional published supplier offer key, for example service_airport. Pass only a key supplied by the provider’s published context; otherwise omit to use the configured default. Preserve it across related calls and retries. It selects a service location and terms, not a booking ID or access grant.
